untrivial-ai-agent-orchestrator-integrat.description: Direct actions on one AO session or PR: stop or interrupt, resume, merge a PR, start a review, screenshot a session's browser, send a session's files, keep a host awake, and recurring AO automations. Use for "stop <session>", "merge <PR>", "review <session>'s PR", "show me what <session> built", "keep the Mac awake tonight", "every night, ...".

Find AO sessions that wait on the user, show each question or approval as tap-to-answer options, and send the answer back to that session, following ao-rules "Decisions" (default, away mode, standing approvals). Use for "what's waiting on me", "answer <session>", "approve it", the AO waiting check routine, and away mode.

untrivial-ai-agent-orchestrator-ao-deskt.description: Launch, restart, or troubleshoot the real AO Electron desktop app from this repository; run a checkout against isolated or real local AO data; combine PR branches for local UI review; and diagnose stale Electron processes, port conflicts, or preload bridge mismatches. Use whenever asked to run, open, show, or visually verify AO frontend changes in the actual desktop app rather than ao preview, dev:web, or mock data.

untrivial-ai-agent-orchestrator-integrat.description: Talk to a project's AO orchestrator: pass the user's request to it, wait for its reply and relay it. The default route for starting or changing work, "catch me up", "why", "what next" and plans. Use for "in <project>: <ask>", "tell the orchestrator ...", "catch me up on <project>", "start work on ...".
Shared rules and the connection helper for every ao-* skill (run Orchestrator from chat). Read before running any ao-* skill.

First run of Orchestrator Bot: find every computer that runs AO, save them as AO hosts, add a remote AO host that has no Grok Bot desktop app, and turn on optional routines. On a computer without Orchestrator.inc it helps install it and get it ready: a coding agent, a first project and the first orchestrator. Use on the first chat, when memory has no "AO hosts" note, or when the user says "set up AO", "add a host", "add remote host", "check my AO setup" or "install Orchestrator".

What AO is doing on every host: which sessions are running, waiting on the user, idle or exited, which PRs are ready to merge or got a review, and a daily digest. Read-only. Use for "status", "what's running", "what's waiting on me", "what's ready to merge", "anything stuck", and the AO daily digest routine.

Update this bot's ao-* skills to the latest published version: check what changed, show it, and after the user's yes download each changed skill, verify its sha256 against the published manifest, and rewrite it. Use for "update Orchestrator Bot", "update the AO bot", "update my AO skills", "what's new in Orchestrator Bot".

untrivial-ai-agent-orchestrator-bug-tria.description: Help clarify human bug reports, search for duplicates, and gather diagnostic evidence separately from a concise issue draft.

untrivial-ai-agent-orchestrator-agents-p.description: Write and maintain pull request descriptions in this repository, including the required change-count header, the before-and-after section, and screenshots or recordings for visible changes.

untrivial-ai-agent-orchestrator-backend-.description: Catalog of the AO (Agent Orchestrator) `ao` CLI: spawning workers, managing sessions and projects, creating reusable Cues, sending messages, controlling the shared browser, previewing pages, and daemon control. Use when using the ao CLI, creating Cues, spawning workers, or managing AO sessions in an AO workspace.
